name: Naveen John
tagline: I build the data and ML systems behind micro-mobility safety research — camera–LiDAR sensor fusion, multi-modal ETL, and the backend services that put derived ride features in researchers' hands.

bullets.text: Design Python ETL pipelines that ingest, time-synchronize, and join 3 data modalities — sensor telemetry, ride video, and tabular trip logs — into one curated store.
bullets.metricHint: cutting per-study data preparation by N%

bullets.text: Build backend REST services over PostgreSQL exposing derived ride features to analytics dashboards, replacing ad-hoc SQL pulls for the research team.
bullets.metricHint: serving N researchers and cutting average query turnaround by N%

bullets.text: Instrument pipelines with schema validation, freshness checks, and alerting so data-quality defects surface before ingest rather than mid-study.
bullets.metricHint: across N stages, saving ~N hrs/week of manual troubleshooting

bullets.text: Built a retrieval-augmented generation pipeline over electronic health records, serving 2 LLMs (GPT-4.1, DeepSeek v3.1) through Azure AI Foundry to answer patient-oriented queries such as procedure recommendation from demographics and medical history.
Designed an LLM evaluation framework on semantic-similarity accuracy metrics, quantifying response disparities across 4 demographic axes — gender, race, ethnicity, and age.
First-authored the resulting study, Evaluating Bias in LLMs' Responses to Patient-Oriented Tasks, submitted to AIM 2026.
Enhanced backend integrations between Salesforce (Apex, SOQL), Java/Python services, and relational databases for enterprise clients, shipping changes into shared codebases owned by multiple teams.
bullets.metricHint: for N enterprise clients across N teams

bullets.text: Diagnosed production incidents through logs, SQL queries, and dependency traces over 16 months, with root-cause documentation and regression tests on every fix.
Partnered with product owners to scope and automate recurring workflows, reducing repeat incidents and removing standing manual effort.
bullets.metricHint: reducing repeat incidents by N% and removing ~N hrs/month
